label: FP
reason: The XSS finding is a false positive. Both flagged values (rememberMe.getName() and rememberMe.getValue()) do not receive user-controlled input. The cookie name is derived from the class name (fullClassName.substring()), and the cookie value is generated using SecureRandom and encoded with ESAPI.Base64 encoder. Neither represents actual user input reaching the HTML sink.

evidence.note: Cookie name derived from class name, cookie value from SecureRandom+ESAPI encoding
